info.text:
The most common 401(k) match, "50% up to 6%," maxes out at 3% of pay (Vanguard How America Saves 2026).
Hypothetical $60,000 salary: putting in 6% ($3,600) gets a $1,800 match; putting in 3% ($1,800) gets $900.
The IRS safe harbor match (100% of the first 3% + 50% of the next 2%) maxes out at 4% of pay. Fidelity's average employer contribution was 4.8% of pay in Q2 2026.
Vesting: a worker's own deferrals are always theirs; regular matches can take up to a 3-year cliff or 6-year graded schedule.
Sources: Vanguard How America Saves 2026; Fidelity Q2 2026 Retirement Analysis; IRS.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
